name: Stored Value Transaction Type 3 Code
definition: Identification of operation to proceed on the stored value account or the stored value card.

ACTV.name: Activate
ACTV.definition: Activate the account or the card.

DUPL.name: Duplicate
DUPL.definition: Duplicate the code or number provided by the loading or activation.

LOAD.name: Load
LOAD.definition: Load the account or the card with money.

RESV.name: Reserve
RESV.definition: Reserve the account (e.g. get an activation code).

DCTV.name: Deactivate
DCTV.definition: Deactivate the account or the card.
